circuits.topology: rectangular series rings; leadouts and turn-to-turn transitions unknown

Arnold-N35UH.br_basis: Published minimum at20C; nominal and maximum retained separately
Arnold-N35UH.coefficient_basis: Published reversible coefficients over20C to grade temperature limit; linear interpolation is a study approximation
Arnold-N35UH.curve_basis: Manufacturer plotted curves use nominal Br/minimum Hci and depend on size/shape; not digitised or represented as measured coupon data
Arnold-N35UH.demag_basis: Unchanged conservative80% Hcj screening factor; not a measured knee or irreversible-demagnetisation model
Arnold-N35UH.density_basis: Manufacturer typical 7.6 g/cm3; not a guaranteed batch value
Arnold-N35UH.recoil_basis: Declared linear-recoil study assumption1.05, not measured Arnold batch permeability

aluminium.source: Nominal geometry mass assumption, alloy/certificate unconfirmed

copper.basis: Declared nominal annealed copper study constants; actual winding conductor certification required.

ferrite.br_basis: Published minimum at20C; nominal and maximum retained separately
ferrite.coefficient_basis: Published reversible coefficients over20C to grade temperature limit; linear interpolation is a study approximation
ferrite.curve_basis: Manufacturer plotted curves use nominal Br/minimum Hci and depend on size/shape; not digitised or represented as measured coupon data
ferrite.demag_basis: Unchanged conservative80% Hcj screening factor; not a measured knee or irreversible-demagnetisation model
ferrite.density_basis: Manufacturer typical 7.6 g/cm3; not a guaranteed batch value
ferrite.recoil_basis: Declared linear-recoil study assumption1.05, not measured Arnold batch permeability

steel.curve_basis: Hand digitized typical 50Hz polarization graph, with exact 2500/5000/10000 A/m table anchors. B=J+mu0H; +/-0.03T and +/-10%H reading uncertainty, not a measured DC/reversible law. High-field extrapolation uses vacuum slope.
steel.facing_grade_hold: Solid facing grade, B-H curve, joints, corrosion and eddy losses unqualified
steel.origin_basis: SIJ Acroni Slovenian electrical steel; UK cut/stack manufacture possible, British raw steel origin not established.

recoil_adapter.inherited_material_proxy_metadata: Frozen solver material_proxy retains its canonical steel/ferrite reference; declared_material_definitions and this adapter specify the active grade

regions.winding_representation: homogenised signed-turn window; actual copper is the stock ledger
